leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a basic service-level indicator (SLI) calculation in a monitoring script
Configure a service-level objective (SLO) threshold and alerting rule
Construct an error budget tracking mechanism for a simulated service
Apply a deployment strategy with canary analysis to minimize risk
Initialize a basic incident response playbook with automated steps
Integrate a simple monitoring dashboard to visualize service health metrics
Manipulate load balancer settings to simulate traffic management during incidents
